title: 18039 - 18039/P1631
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Measuring Block Readings for Accelerator Pedal
Kontrol edin:  Voltage Signals from ECM to Throttle Pedal (see factory repair manual)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and Connectors from ECM to Accelerator Pedal
technicalNotes: There are 2 sensors in the accelerator pedal, both measure the same except that they are working in opposite directions. This means one counts from 0 to 100, while the other one counts from 100 to 0.
